import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 9.5,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

# Okabe-Ito palette
C_QWEN = '#0072B2'   # deep blue
C_LLAMA = '#D55E00'  # orange-red

turns = np.arange(1, 11)

# Base model AR GAR (gen mode, 10 turns)
qwen_base = np.array([0.0418, 0.0241, 0.0224, 0.013, 0.0133, 0.0086, 0.0078, 0.008, 0.0157, 0.0064])
llama_base = np.array([0.0263, 0.0183, 0.0087, 0.0055, 0.006, 0.0035, 0.0038, 0.0037, 0.005, 0.0026])

# Qwen TG v7 AR eval (s123, 10 turns, 5 conversations)
qwen_tg = np.array([0.0522, 0.0385, 0.0167, 0.0200, 0.0178, 0.0183, 0.0126, 0.0139, 0.0071, 0.0145])

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.2, 3.2))

# Plot curves
ax.plot(turns, qwen_base * 100, '-o', color=C_QWEN, markersize=5,
        markerfacecolor=C_QWEN, markeredgewidth=0, label='Qwen-2.5-7B Base', zorder=3)
ax.plot(turns, llama_base * 100, '-s', color=C_LLAMA, markersize=5,
        markerfacecolor=C_LLAMA, markeredgewidth=0, label='Llama-3.1-8B Base', zorder=3)
ax.plot(turns, qwen_tg * 100, '--o', color=C_QWEN, markersize=4, alpha=0.55,
        markerfacecolor='white', markeredgecolor=C_QWEN, markeredgewidth=1.0,
        label='Qwen-2.5-7B + TG (AR)', zorder=2)

# Annotate relative drops
qwen_drop = (1 - qwen_base[-1] / qwen_base[0]) * 100
llama_drop = (1 - llama_base[-1] / llama_base[0]) * 100

t1 = ax.annotate(f'{qwen_drop:.0f}% drop',
            xy=(10, qwen_base[-1] * 100), xytext=(8.0, 3.2),
            fontsize=8, color=C_QWEN,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_QWEN, lw=0.8))
t1.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='white')])

t2 = ax.annotate(f'{llama_drop:.0f}% drop',
            xy=(10, llama_base[-1] * 100), xytext=(7.8, 0.8),
            fontsize=8, color=C_LLAMA,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_LLAMA, lw=0.8))
t2.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='white')])

ax.set_xlabel('Turn')
ax.set_ylabel('GAR (%)')
ax.set_xticks(turns)
ax.set_xlim(0.5, 10.5)
ax.set_ylim(0, 6.0)
ax.legend(loc='upper right', framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='none')
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.15, zorder=0)

plt.tight_layout()

outdir = '/root/turn_residual_gating/artifacts'
for ext in ['pdf', 'png']:
    path = f'{outdir}/fig_ar_gar_perturn.{ext}'
    plt.savefig(path)
    print(f'Saved: {path}')
plt.close()
